source_cases.statement: Andrews describes rainwater in a dark bowl.
Andrews also names a rainwater cauldron context.
Andrews describes a pool formed after rain.
Andrews describes an undisturbed observer able to look into the water.
Andrews recommends soft,half-focused gazing rather than intense staring.
Andrews gives perceived fogginess a symbolic opening/awakening account;this verifies no extraordinary ability.
Andrews describes possible later colors,images andfaces as impressions;none are required orassigned a universal meaning here.
